title: candidate-shadow-week-summary-team-health-feb28-2026
body:
Context and purpose:
- This doc captures notes from the candidate "shadow" week (Feb 23–27) where three finalists were paired with eng-platform teams for short rotations. Also includes a snapshot of onboarding friction items and an ad-hoc team health pulse from the week.

Attendees (shadow sessions + debrief):
- Sophie Chen (owner, shadow coordinator)
- Aisha Patel (hiring lead, interviews)
- Ben Huang (senior infra eng, buddy for candidate C)
- Marco Alvarez (sre/ops buddy for candidate B)
- Riley Thompson (platform eng PM)
- Interviewer rotation: Dana, Kurt, Melissa (notes consolidated below)

High-level outcomes:
- We observed good systems thinking across all three candidates; each showed strength in debugging complex infra issues but varied on production tradeoffs (cost vs latency).
- Candidate A (backend infra) recommended for hire with a condition: needs more exposure to Redwood’s serving runtime internals (approx 4–6 weeks ramp).
- Candidate B (sre leaning) is a strong cultural fit but slower on our internal orchestration patterns; recommend follow-up take-home on autoscaler scenarios before final offer.
- Candidate C (embedded infra/ops) performed well on runbook creation and incident postmortem; flagged for potential senior IC track but pinged for leadership readiness check.

Detailed candidate notes:
- Candidate A (id: cand-A):
  - Shadowed Ben on a KV-cache mismatch debug (ticket JIRA-3421). Candidate quickly formulated hypothesis about stale cache shards and suggested a non-invasive canary to validate.
  - Strengths: clear runbook-first mindset, good telemetry reading, comfortable with flamegraph traces and kernel-level noise.
  - Risks: limited exposure to Triton-style batching internals. Onboarding plan: pair with runtime team for 2 sessions/week for first month.
  - Hiring recommendation: Offer (IC3) with 30-day technical mentorship goals.

- Candidate B (id: cand-B):
  - Paired with Marco on autoscaler simulation (JIRA-3499). Showed solid chaos engineering instincts but initially missed our CPU vs GPU scheduling nuances.
  - Strengths: incident response ownership, calm under noisy alerts, empathy with product owners.
  - Risks: needs deeper familiarity with our custom scheduler heuristics and cost-aware routing policies.
  - Action: assign a 48-hour take-home modeling exercise focused on rate-based autoscaling; revisit by Mar 10.

- Candidate C (id: cand-C):
  - Worked with team on runbook and postmortem draft for a recent rate-limiting regression. Draft was pragmatic and prioritized rollback/mitigation.
  - Strengths: strong documentation and on-call hygiene; good cross-team communication.
  - Risks: ambiguous around mentoring junior engineers (leadership signals weaker).
  - Hiring recommendation: Hire (IC2–IC3 flex) pending reference check and an org-fit conversation on mentorship expectations.

Onboarding friction log (items surfaced during shadow week):
- Dev laptop imaging delay: two hires last week waited ~3 days for GPU-enabled VM access. Ticketed as internal ops backlog (JIRA-ops-1120).
- VPN/KMS onboarding: one candidate couldn’t access staging KMS due to stale SSO mapping; follow-up needed with security to streamline service-account onboarding (assigned to Aisha).
- Local debugging: missing local replica datasets (~20GB) for runtime profiling — short-term fix: provide a lightweight sampled dataset and a documented profiling checklist. Owner: Ben.
- Documentation gaps: runtime-contrib onboarding doc is out of date (mentions old quantization flags). Action: create a living checklist for first-30-days tasks. Owner: Riley & Sophie.

Buddy-rotation feedback (from new hires / candidates):
- Positive: buddy rotations helped candidates get realistic on-call context within 24h. Specific shoutout to Ben for practical debugging walkthroughs.
- Improvement: shorten rotation notes to a 1-pager ‘what I learned’ for quicker handoffs.
- Suggestion: formalize a 2-week buddy schedule that maps to concrete milestones (access, local run, first PR).

Team health snapshot (quick pulse from Feb 27 standup + ad-hoc check-ins):
- Hiring sentiment: 2 hires expected to close in March (pending offers), which should temporarily relieve bus factor on runtime infra tasks.
- Burn indicators: a couple of ICs reported >50% context-switching last week due to incident triage; SRE rotation bandwidth is tight.
- Morale: generally positive; small frustration about PR review latency (avg 3.7 days for platform PRs last sprint).
- Signals to watch: onboarding time-to-first-PR metric (goal: <=10 calendar days). Current baseline: 14 days. Owner: Riley to propose process changes.

Unresolved questions / decisions needed:
- Do we require a take-home for all SRE-ish candidates? (Pros: better signal; Cons: slows hiring funnel). Proposal: keep take-home optional but required for senior roles. Vote needed from hiring committee by Mar 5.
- What’s acceptable ramp plan for Candidate A if we hire (mentor capacity)? Need mentor assignment before offer.
- Should we prioritize automating GPU VM provisioning to reduce imaging time to <24h? Cost/benefit analysis needed.

Action items (owners + tentative due dates):
- Aisha: finalize interview feedback rubric for SRE candidates (due Mar 5).
- Ben: provide sampled profiling dataset + quickstart doc (due Mar 6).
- Riley: draft 2-week buddy schedule + propose PR review SLAs (due Mar 9).
- Sophie: run reference checks for Candidate C and schedule mentorship-readiness quick chat for Candidate A (due Mar 6).
- Security contact (cc Aisha): resolve SSO/KMS mapping edge-case; status update by Mar 4.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep candidate shadow week — high signal, worth the scheduling pain. More structure next round (explicit checklist).
- Consider a short postmortem template for candidate-led runbooks to compare across candidates.

References and links:
- JIRA-3421: KV-cache mismatch debug (internal ticket)
- JIRA-3499: Autoscaler simulation worklog
- CONFLUENCE-PLAT-281: Onboarding checklist (needs update)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/918 (example small runtime fix used in shadow exercise)

Next check-in:
- Quick hiring committee sync Mar 5 (15m) to decide about Candidate B take-home and Candidate A mentor assignment.
- Follow-up onboarding cleanup review Mar 10 (30m).

-- Sophie
